MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Neil Diamond All Time Greatest Hits and Melody Road feel like natural next choices because The Bang Years gives me a familiar connection to his voice and songs.",
    "Standing Ovation fits my interest in Stages and A Musical Affair: stage songs and expressive vocal performances are something I want to hear more of."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Prince, Earth Wind & Fire, and Four Tops collections do not fit my current mood simply because they contain familiar hits; I am seeking gentler vocals and theatrical songs.",
    "Grand Funk Railroad and Different Shades Of Blue lean toward hard rock or blues guitar, which does not match the relaxing and vocal music I want now.",
    "Ultimate Collection gives me no clear artist connection, so I cannot confidently connect it to music I have enjoyed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat greatest-hits collections as interchangeable, although whose songs they contain matters much more to me.",
    "My interest in Neil Diamond seems to have been stretched into a broader interest in older popular music across sounds I am not currently seeking."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in Stages, A Musical Affair, and Lead With Your Heart suggests that expressive singing and stage repertoire deserve more attention.",
    "The Downton Abbey recordings and my most recent relaxing classical selection suggest a quieter listening mood that many of these choices miss."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in Neil Diamond and stage songs, but extended it too broadly to familiar hits with very different sounds."
}
